title: Implement canonical relationship writers and predecessor admission
body:
## Implemented prerequisite and current binding

Implements the selected eight-point canonical relationship writer after qualified personal planning PR8, merge660a6f880769edcf9e52cc5e21e477a5545133f8. Both head and base are riatzukiza/rheos. Writer remains InProgress; parity5 and the epic remain Incoming. B1/B2/B3 encounter, consumed mood and automatic maker graph recall remain unimplemented/unverified. Source implementation is not installed consumer enforcement.

Current head `5c44cd7b22e492af7f8ccae3f0c4f4a89e795a83`, base `660a6f880769edcf9e52cc5e21e477a5545133f8`; auto-merge remains off. Ordinary RED22e15295e2ee15a6400d65a32a290c3f860c7ecd then GREEN5c44cd7 preserve history. Earlier28b approvals and historical withdrawal are not current-head qualification.

## Current review repairs

Native CodeRabbit full request6068511179 completed via6068513141 at20:37:33UTC. COMMENTED5462560894 assessed all59 inputs on28b2a9bf11e98b86628f3f5cf75ebbb0adbfab72 and raised three findings, not an approval:

- 4223884239: creation now passes the already normalized parent to the existence decision. Empty/whitespace/null means absence, with no parent frontmatter and nil event value.
- 4223884217: HTTP converts raw type/parent/epic values through clj->js while retaining malformed input and relationship diagnostics. The public board handler's native JSON retains arrays/objects rather than collection internals.
- 4223884206: CLI explicitly maps conflict to refusal3 and partial-effect to error4. All previous codes remain unchanged. The earlier separate-process exit4 proof is retained as history and the report appends the current correction.

The earlier traversal4223364075 fix excludes exactly the owning reservation metadata before lstat; missing selected cards/roots still refuse incomplete reads. Identity4223364089 was explicitly withdrawn by its opener4223418686 on9b753; this is not author rejection or new-head withdrawal qualification. Canonical pr-flow's across-head withdrawal gap remains tracked in riatzukiza/.agents issue25. No local policy override or fabricated independent agreement.

Actual separate compiled CLI2236725bytes/SHA25676251ae169560fb43a2239998ac117297c7f4f208874fe06b8d1463d3f692f3c: one owner holds its executable gate; four independent frontmatter/create/comment/move processes each conflict/exit3 with exact card/ledger/token bytes unchanged. Releasing the gate lets the owner publish. Returned and separately read frontmatter both carry the new status; prior events remain an exact prefix, owned reservation releases, all processes are reaped and private fixture removed. Raw proof10031bytes/SHA2568896e2cfa84349535c4c19d8ee2f25b99ab674958f7364576a84825b29be00ff.

The verification report and lossless log wrappers retain all prior attempts: initial delimiter error, wrong event nil-key expectation, mock CLJS decoder artifact, four corrected interop warnings, and actual final RED/GREEN. The mock500 is not claimed as actual native HTTPfailure. Partial-effect regression performs the file effect, fails its event append, reports actual readback/exit4 and leaves existing history unchanged.

## Review and delivery boundaries

MiMo APPROVED5462365551/all98pages59inputs and hosted run37836132228/all10gates/241tests2219assertions applied to28b. MiMo5462115928 and run37832580278 applied to9b753. These remain raw native historical evidence; none transfers to this changed head. New exact-head hosted gates/reviews are required. Existing automatic MiMo route is reused; native Codex quota6067513632 retains actual UNKNOWN reset. Kimi has no verified available route here. CodeRabbit full review must respect actual included cooldown and pending deduplication; no paid/on-demand usage or duplicate attempt.

The complete isolated CLI/HTTP/MCP matrix, reciprocal races, immutable package consumption and consumer admission belong to the already selected parity successor. Unknown ownership is never transferred by elapsed time. Participating writers serialize; manual/nonparticipating writers are outside that guarantee. File/event publication remains non-atomic with explicit phase/readback. This does not deliver the accepted character loop.

All qualified-base/previous-head receipt and reflection bytes remain exact prefixes; native event ledger is unchanged by this repair. New execution/correction rows are appended in their owning repositories. No historical attribution rewrite or receipt compatibility migration. Current Receipt River law's repo requirement remains on new rows. No spore created/promoted.

Existing caches were reused below the20GiB local floor, with no full copy or dependency installation. No live board, watcher, maker, owner, PM2, cloud, model, credentials or publication service changed. Heartbeat remains paused; goal ACTIVE.
